findings.text: non-blocking: `assert Path(source) == shims / Path(destination).name` compares the composed mask source against a path built from `shim_directory()`, the product function the composition itself calls, so a regression in `shim_directory()` moves both sides together and the assertion stays green; the same self-reference sits at line 584 (SHIM_HOME_ENV value) and line 634 (`fence_program()`), and only `Path(destination).is_file()` at 610, the name equality at 615 and `source in masked` at 618 test the argv against an independent fact.

non-blocking: `assert masks` and `assert relays` (605-606) assert a property of the host PATH, because the guard's copies come from scheduler_shields' PATH search (reckon/_worker_fence.py:2340 on main) and the fixture neither sets PATH nor supplies a scheduler directory; on a host where no sbatch/srun/salloc resolves the composition masks nothing and the file reddens for an environment reason rather than a guard regression.

non-blocking: the quoted head run re-entered the fence as an srun step of the worker's own held job (gate/merged-gate.log line 1 is the shim's task re-entry message), so SLURM_JOB_ID was set, while the done_when requires the file to pass as a job with SLURM_JOB_ID unset; neither the fragment nor the manifest records that condition being set up.
